content_sections.heading: DIPR Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following conditions to be considered for DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026: The candidate must have passed ITI in the trade relevant to the post applied for, including certification under SCVT (State Council for Vocational Training) or NCVET (National Council for Vocational Education and Training). The candidate must be registered on the Apprenticeship Portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in . Registration on this portal is mandatory; applications of candidates who are not registered will not be considered. The candidate must satisfy the minimum and maximum age limits prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961, the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, and applicable guidelines, as amended from time to time. (The specific age limit in years is not mentioned in the notification.) The candidate must possess the requisite educational and physical qualifications, if any, prescribed for the respective trade under NAPS 2.0 apprenticeship norms. (Trade-wise educational qualification details are not specified in the notification beyond the ITI/SCVT/NCVET requirement.)

content_sections.heading: DIPR Apprentice Salary/Stipend
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will be paid the applicable minimum stipend prescribed for their trade, on a monthly basis through the prescribed banking mode. The stipend ranges from ₹9,600/- to ₹10,560/- per month depending on the trade, as detailed in the trade-wise vacancy table above. Selected candidates must furnish valid bank account details linked with Aadhaar, wherever required, at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: DIPR Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: The DIPR Apprentice selection process consists of the following steps, as per the notification: A duly constituted Board, approved by the Competent Authority, will scrutinise applications and shortlist candidates based on the prescribed eligibility and selection criteria and the number of vacancies available. Selection will be made on the basis of marks obtained in the respective qualifying examination/trade, followed by an interaction/interview, as applicable, depending on the number of candidates applying for the advertised vacancies. The final merit list will be prepared category-wise (General/OBC/SC/ST), as applicable under the rules. Offer letters to selected candidates will be issued through email only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through either of the following two methods, as per the official notification: Visit the Apprenticeship Portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in . Search for the establishment using its Establishment Code: E08260700022 . Apply for the relevant trade for which you are eligible. Download and fill the prescribed application form (enclosed with the official notification) in block letters. Attach scanned copies of the duly filled application form along with the requisite documents/certificates. Email the scanned copies in PDF format to [email protected] before the closing date of submission. Candidates should note that registration on the Apprenticeship Portal is mandatory for consideration of candidature, regardless of the mode of application used. Educational qualification certificates ITI certificate Caste certificate, wherever applicable NATS/NAPS enrolment proof Other relevant supporting documents, as listed in the application form

content_sections.heading: Terms and Conditions of DIPR Apprenticeship Training
content_sections.text: The duration of apprenticeship training is 12 months and cannot be extended under any circumstances. Every apprentice will be treated as a trainee and not as a worker; labour laws will not apply except as provided under the Apprentices Act, 1961. DIPR will not provide government quarters, hostel accommodation, or transport facilities during the training period. Selected candidates must submit a Police Verification Certificate after joining. The Contract of Apprenticeship will be executed online through the NAPS-Apprenticeship Portal. On completion of training, apprentices will undergo assessment as per the applicable procedure, and results will be considered for issuance of the National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC). Completion of apprenticeship does not confer any right to regular employment at DIPR or extension of the training period. DIPR reserves the right to increase, decrease, withdraw, or cancel the vacancies or the selection process without assigning any reason. Any dispute arising from the recruitment or training process will be subject to the jurisdiction of competent courts at Delhi.

faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade, including certification under SCVT or NCVET.

faq.answer: Candidates must meet the minimum and maximum age limits prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. The exact age limit in years is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the Apprenticeship Portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in using Establishment Code E08260700022, or by emailing the filled application form to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on marks obtained in the qualifying examination/trade, followed by an interaction/interview as applicable, with a category-wise merit list.
